summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private. Evidence: official API documentation establishes access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish rights to store, transform, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize returned data. Fleet compliance is technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, 6 unknown. Analytics and revenue attribution remain yellow; $4.92 aggregate commission is unattributed and site-attributed commission is $0. Do not claim certification, ROI, or site-attributed revenue.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 legal tasks are closed. Partial evidence exists for official API documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms; no task is closable. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source fields, provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, alert identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Keep outreach unsent and preserve the private gate.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data is counsel_required and launch-blocked; user alert rules and sync results are evidence_needed; GA4 analytics is evidence_needed; operational logs and hosting data are evidence_needed. No legal data-use item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Compliance and data-quality triage: incomplete telemetry is not a general launch blocker. Permit ordinary reversible growth only where existing consent, cookie and analytics disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, data provenance, copyright/trademark boundaries, and platform-policy constraints are preserved. Do not expand tracking, monetization, regulated or age-sensitive use, or unsupported claims on failed or unknown site evidence. Preserve aggregate revenue as unattributed and do not treat missing analytics as zero.

Private-site decision: keep SearchWoot private. No public exposure, alert expansion, rights-dependent monetization, deployment, configuration or credential change, external outreach, or spend is authorized. The prepared permission request remains unsent pending human-counsel review and explicit owner authorization. Continue only bounded read-only evidence work and internal draft preparation.
